title: LADM LA_Feature (JSON-FG 1.0.0 Profile)
description: Base schema for all LADM spatial feature classes. Combines OGC JSON-FG Feature 1.0.0 with LADM VersionedObject lifecycle tracking. The JSON-FG 'time' block maps to LADM realWorldLifespanVersion (begin/endRealWorldLifespanVersion). The system lifespan (lifespanVersion) and its source references are recorded inside 'properties'.

allOf.$comment: 1. INHERITANCE: OGC JSON-FG Feature 1.0.0 (geometry, place, time, featureType, coordRefSys)
2. INHERITANCE: LADM VersionedObject (lifespanVersion, source references, quality)
3. LADM Feature base constraints: mandatory id, type, and optional coordRefSys + profile declarations

id.description: Globally unique feature identifier. OGC API - Features compatible: UUID or URI.

coordRefSys.description: CRS for the 'place' geometry (OGC URI, e.g. 'urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::3765'). Inherits from collection-level coordRefSys when absent.

ladm_profiles.description: List of URIs declaring which LADM profiles this feature instance conforms to (e.g. INSPIRE, national cadastre profile). Inspired by STAC stac_extensions pattern. Processors can use these URIs to locate additional validation schemas.
